entries.name: DOCUSIGN_INTEGRATION_KEY
entries.description: The integration key (client id) of the KaratOS app in the store's Docusign Apps and Keys page. The app uses JWT Grant, so it needs no secret key or redirect for syncing.
howToGet: Signed in to Docusign as an administrator, open Settings > Apps and Keys and choose Add App and Integration Key. Name it KaratOS.
Copy the Integration Key it shows.

entries.name: DOCUSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY
entries.description: The RSA private key of the KaratOS app's key pair, which signs each JWT Grant sign-in. As Docusign shows it, or base64-encoded on one line. It is never sent anywhere.
howToGet: On the KaratOS app in Settings > Apps and Keys, under Service Integration, choose Generate RSA.
Copy the private key straight into the host's secret store, either as shown or base64-encoded on one line. Docusign shows it once. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
Leave the app's secret keys and redirect URIs empty, apart from the one redirect the consent step in docs/integrations/docusign.md needs.

entries.name: DOCUSIGN_USER_ID
entries.description: The API user id of the Docusign user the connector signs in as. Make it a user whose permission profile can't send envelopes, and who has shared access to the envelopes of the people who send agreements: Docusign has no read-only scope, so this is what keeps the sign-in from being able to send.
howToGet: In Docusign Settings > Users, add a user for KaratOS with the Viewer permission profile, which can't send envelopes (or a copy of it with sending turned off), and give it shared access to the envelopes of each person who sends agreements.
Open Settings > Users, choose that user, and copy its API Username, a GUID.

entries.name: DOCUSIGN_ACCOUNT_ID
entries.description: The API account id of the Docusign account whose envelopes are read.
howToGet: Open Settings > Apps and Keys and copy the API Account ID shown under My Account Information.

entries.name: DOCUSIGN_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: Which Docusign the account is on: production (the default) or developer, for a free developer account used in testing.
howToGet: Leave unset for a store's own account. Set developer only for a Docusign developer account.

entries.name: DOCUSIGN_CONNECT_HMAC_KEYS
entries.description: The HMAC keys of the store's Docusign Connect configuration, separated by commas, which sign each delivery (X-Docusign-Signature-1 and so on). Only needed once Connect is turned on; the scheduled sync works without it.
howToGet: In Docusign Settings > Connect, open Connect Keys and choose Add Secret Key. Docusign shows the key once.
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
On the Connect configuration, choose the JSON SIM format, include the envelope summary and recipients, and turn on Include HMAC Signature.
